title: Android Vulkan Material Preview crashes Godot Editor on PowerVR BXM-8-256
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.6.1.stable, 4.7.stable and later versions

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Android 16 (SDK 36 build 301300004) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan 1.3.303 (Mobile) - integrated PowerVR B-Series BXM-8-256 -  (8 threads) - Android (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Godot Editor crashes when opening Material Preview for certain .gdshader resources on my Android device using the Vulkan/Mobile renderer.
The crash is shader-specific. Two shaders from my project consistently trigger the crash:
```triplanar_pbr.gdshader```
```character/body.gdshader```
These shaders can render normally when used in an actual 3D scene. The crash occurs specifically when using the Material Preview/editor material inspection workflow.
Other materials/shaders do not necessarily reproduce the issue, so this does not appear to be a general Material Preview crash.
The issue is reproducible across multiple projects and persists after restarting the device and clearing Godot/project caches. I also observed that the issue became apparent after updating from Android/XOS 15 to Android 16/XOS 16, which changed the device's reported Vulkan version from ```1.1.170``` to ```1.3.303```. I cannot confirm that the driver update is the direct cause.
Godot's Compatibility/OpenGL renderer does not reproduce this exact crash, but the entire editor experiences severe graphical glitches/jitter under that renderer on my device, making it unsuitable as a workaround.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached MRP using the Vulkan/Mobile renderer.
2. Create a new ShaderMaterial.
3. Assign triplanar_pbr.gdshader to the ShaderMaterial.
4. Open the ShaderMaterial in Material Preview.
5. Observe that the Godot Editor crashes.
6. Reopen the project and repeat steps 2–4 with uma/body.gdshader.
7. Observe that the Godot Editor crashes again.
8. Repeat the same process with a simple/non-crashing shader for comparison.
9. Observe that the non-crashing shader does not reproduce the crash.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32563604/mrp.zip)
